title: Christmas Stories
summary: "Christmas Stories" by Jacob A. Riis is a collection of short stories likely written in the late 19th century. Their awe transforms into a desire to surprise him through their own generosity, as they decide to pool their modest savings to fill the Kid’s stocking with gifts.
